title: PlaceReasoner-Beta: Reasoning-Driven Macro Placement and Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2609.21263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design. Despite decades of research, existing approaches predominantly optimize hand-crafted proxy objectives, such as estimated wirelength, and typically produce placements through one-shot numerical optimization, limiting their ability to incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise, and downstream physical-design feedback in a unified loop. We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a closed-loop reasoning problem rather than black-box optimization. translated_title: PlaceReasoner-Beta：推理驱动的宏单元布局与基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.21263v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：宏单元的自动布局仍然是VLSI物理设计中的一项根本性挑战。尽管经过数十年的研究，现有方法主要优化手工设计的代理目标（如估计线长），并且通常通过一次性数值优化来生成布局，这限制了它们在统一闭环中整合视觉布局上下文、成文的设计专业知识以及下游物理设计反馈的能力。我们提出了PlaceReasoner-Beta，这是一个由验证器引导的多智能体框架，它将宏单元布局重新表述为一个闭环推理问题，而非黑盒优化。视觉语言模型（VLM）规划器根据布局图图像、宏单元规格和连接结构生成候选布局；几何验证器强制执行物理合法性和专家布局原则；物理验证器利用早期实现反馈来改进候选方案；布线后优化器进一步……
tldr: 该论文提出PlaceReasoner-Beta，一个由验证器引导的多智能体框架，将VLSI宏单元布局从传统黑盒优化重新表述为闭环推理问题，通过视觉语言模型规划器、几何验证器、物理验证器和布线后优化器的协同工作，在统一流程中融合视觉布局信息、设计专业知识与物理设计反馈。
en_tdlr: PlaceReasoner-Beta is a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a closed-loop reasoning problem rather than black-box optimization, coordinating a VLM planner, geometric verifier, physical verifier, and post-route optimizer to integrate visual layout context, design expertise, and physical-design feedback in a unified loop.
